label: Self-check: where its temp folders live and how they are removed

params.name: roots
params.label: Where a run keeps its temp folders - the first whose drive exists (owner 2026-10-21: temp on D:); none = the computer's temp folder

params.name: retries
params.label: Tries to remove the run's folder after the run ends (Windows lets go of a file a moment late)

params.name: stale_hours
params.label: A run folder older than this (a run that was killed) is removed by the next run

description_nl: 2026-11-28: C: held 7,720 tmp*/perm-* folders (46 GB, each a portal data copy with secret.json) left by self-checks whose TemporaryDirectory(ignore_cleanup_errors=True) failed silently on a held sqlite file; C: fell under machine.check min_disk_gb and Main Machine stopped taking work. tools/tempscope.py runs the self-check with TEMP pointed at one run folder here and removes it after the run's process has ended.
